messages:
maya: Quick sync: webinar launch on inference econ Tues. Need a short battlecard, two hero soundbites for the LP, and a lead-routing spec the form can emit. Can we lock in before EOD? :hourglass:
leo: I can run quick comparatives (p50/p95 latency + cost/1k tokens) for chat (2k ctx) and embeddings (batch64). Will include hosted vs dedicated variants. ETA 3pm.
tori: I'll capture cold vs warm tail and note caching priming. Small note: quantify assumptions (quantization, batch size) in appendix.
sam: Routing proposal: hidden form fields -> webinar_signal=true, region=NA/EU/APAC, intent=hot/warm/cold. Rules:
- hot -> AE assign immediately
- warm -> SDR nurture + 1-call follow-up
- cold -> email nurture drip
Can we make the webhook payload JSON with those keys?
jordan: Yup. I will add hidden inputs and POST to /hooks/lead-route. Test payload: {"webinar_signal":"true","region":"NA","intent":"hot"}. Need final field names.
maya: Hero soundbites draft: 1) "Production-first controls for latency and unit cost" 2) "One serving API across hosted → dedicated → private" Thoughts?
leo: Make #1 clearer: "Reduce unit cost while keeping sub-100ms token latency" might be risky. Use "significantly reduces unit cost" instead.
maya: OK: "Significantly reduces unit cost while controlling latency" + link to appendix for numbers. Use "up to" when we reference percent.
tori: Add small callout: "fallbacks keep apps online during capacity spikes" — good competitor differentiator vs managed cloud endpoints.
sam: SDR needs: quick rebut bullets vs cloud vendors and infra-only players. I can draft a 1-pager: three top objections and short responses.
leo: Uploading artifacts: lp_bench_chat_2k_3881239999.csv and p95_chart_3881239999.png. Numbers annotated with quant/batching assumptions.
sfdc-bot: Reminder: update Marketo form mapping for landing page before 09:00 tomorrow.
jordan: I'll push the webhook change to staging and share curl test.
maya: Great. I'll assemble the battlecard draft and tag SDRs for 10am handoff. If no hot edits, we'll release copy to the LP and routing tomorrow morning. :rocket:
